name: Till
source: A demon, a familiar of Neyris and her closest subordinate. Although he can shape-shift, Till prefers to be in demon or crow forms. He has a sarcastic, spiteful temper so Neyris is constantly being mocked by her own slave. The mistress never shows it, but she has a soft spot for Till.
